SPECIFIC FOOTSTEP: the LARGE LEADING BOOT is at the BOTTOM LEFT of the picture (viewerLEFT), projecting towardcamera with its plain brown SOLE clearly visible. The SMALL TRAILING BOOT is at BOTTOM RIGHT (viewerRIGHT), set fartherback and supporting. This is the opposite of Image2: do NOT put the large leadingboot on the right.
